description: The bar chart titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment" compares the runtime performance of different models in seconds. The vertical axis represents runtime in seconds, ranging from 0 to 400 with major gridlines at intervals of 50. The horizontal axis lists five categories: "Our Joint Framework," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude." The chart uses two colors to differentiate between models: dark green for "Our Joint Framework" and light blue for "LLM Models." The runtime for "Our Joint Framework" is 77 seconds. The runtimes for the LLM models are: 190 seconds for ChatGPT, 365 seconds for DeepSeek, 172 seconds for LLaMA, and 243 seconds for Claude. The chart shows that "Our Joint Framework" has a significantly lower runtime compared to all the LLM models, with DeepSeek having the highest runtime among the models tested.
